question: Related Questions Q. Intercourse 2575 views Q. I would like to say may Allah Subhanahu Ta'alaa reward all the Ulema (espeacially the ifta department) that are working in this site. Alhamdulillah, I practice Islam, but fall short in many aspects and become heedless in sin sometimes frequently. I pray Allah give me Istiqamat (I say this not humbly but truthfully). I also attend the Weekly istema here and attend the khanqah of a shaykh very much connected to the Ulema of Deoband. I hope the information I provided is helpful in deriving an interpretation of a dream. The question is regarding a dream that I saw a few months ago. I live in Toronto, Canada and I got arrested by the police and then they took me in to prison. Upon arriving in my jail cell, I immediately realized there is no path now other then to to turn to Allah. I prayed and prayed on my Jainamaz within the jail cell and eventually got released. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 155680 Country: India Title: Doing tawaf in dream Question: I saw a dream that I am doing tawaf. There are very few people or even no one else doing tawaf at that time. I did tawaf very easily and that I went to Hajr-e-Aswad and kissed it and it was very easy as there was no one else. what is the interpretation of this dream? Answer ID: 155680 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 167/137/B=2/1439) The dream tells that you shall be blessed with Hajj, in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
